markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Terrace
markers.note: Parasols, tables, a view over the falls. Players idle here between runs.

markers.name: INT_Waterfall_Curtain
markers.note: There is a room behind it. There is a room behind three of the four.

markers.name: INT_The_Ascending_Stones
markers.note: Stepping stones up to the floating islands. They sink if you hesitate.

markers.name: INT_Mist_Ruin
markers.note: A building the mist keeps hiding. Its floor plan is not consistent.

markers.name: INT_The_Parasol_That_Is_Not_One
markers.note: Opens into a chute down to a lower valley.

markers.name: INT_Secret_Portal
markers.note: A portal in a world that is not a hub. Leads to one random reality.

markers.name: INT_The_Island_Bell
markers.note: Rings across the whole valley. Every player hears it and knows roughly where.

markers.name: INT_Field_Notes
markers.note: Someone catalogued this place. Their last entry is unfinished.

markers.name: INT_The_Long_Rope_Bridge
markers.note: Two players' weight makes it stable. One player's makes it swing.

markers.name: INT_Creature_Nest
markers.note: Not hostile. Curious. Follows you for a while and then does not.

markers.name: INT_The_Overlook
markers.note: The postcard shot. Emote here and it is worth extra reputation.
